thread:
leo: Starting staggered rollout for v2.7.0-phi. Plan: EU canary 4% -> US progressive (10% steps) -> APAC warm then open. Change window 00:30-04:30 UTC. Rollback triggers: 5xx >1.5% for 3m OR p95 >1200ms. Pin embedder to 3.2.0-compat. Release notes: https://redwood/release/v2.7.0

deploy-bot: [deploybot] EU canary start: service=ingest variant=v2.7.0-phi region=eu slices=1/25 ts=3467890150

sam: Quick capacity check: EU dedicated pool has 6 spare GPUs, warm-pool 35% primed. Looks safe for 4%. I'll mute heavy batch jobs at +5m.

ops-oncall: Dashboards live. Alerts set: 5xx >=1.5% -> #ops-alerts, p95 >=1200ms -> #ops-alerts. Adding transient kv-miss >8% alert.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] EU health @6m: p95=410ms, 5xx=0.2%, gpu_util=58% Status=GREEN

leo: EU green. Proceed to US slice 1 (10%). Keep 10m hold between slices. APAC warm-standby at 25%.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] US slice 1 start: region=us slices=1/10 ts=3467890220

deploy-bot: [deploybot] US health @4m: p95=520ms, 5xx=0.9% OK

sam: Spinning extra warm-pool for US slice 2, cache-prefill in-flight. Note: worker.default_timeout=30s for this variant.

leo: If US slice 2 sees >=1.5% 5xx, hold and triage. No auto-rollback until we try quick mitigations (timeout bump, batch_size tweak).

deploy-bot: [deploybot] US slice 2 start: region=us slices=2/10 ts=3467890265

deploy-bot: [deploybot] US slice 2 @3m: 5xx=1.7% -> ALERT to #ops-alerts

ops-oncall: Pausing ramp. Triage: seeing 502s from async-worker queue depth spike. Recommend bumping worker.timeout to 60s and lowering batch_size from 64->48 for US.

sam: Applying overrides: worker.timeout=60s, runtime.batch_size=48 ts=3467890272

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Re-eval @2m: 5xx dropped to 0.6%, p95=580ms. Alert cleared. Holding slice 2 for 20m before ramp.

anya: I'll add a note to release notes: "Pinned embedder 3.2.0-compat; temporary batch_size and worker timeout adjustments applied during US ramp."

docs: Updated release changelog with mitigation note and rollback criteria link.

leo: Good recovery. Continue staggered ramp after holds; APAC remains warm until US+EU stable for 1h. Thanks team :thumbsup:
